metadata.name: E. fimbriata oocyte composition measurements (2014)
metadata.description: Measurements of temperature, salinity, and biochemical composition (lipids, protein, calorific content, elemental ratios) of the marine organism E. fimbriata oocytes collected at two sites (Foundiougne and Djifer) in Senegal during February 2014.

metadata.name: MITAPI 2015‑2010 Difference Dataset
metadata.description: A catalog of NetCDF files containing MITAPI difference data for several variables (AGR, ENE, IND, PPA, PRO). Each row lists the file name, format, size and download URL.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta measurements (March 2011)
metadata.description: Time‑stamped observations collected at the Elwha River Delta, including latitude, longitude, elevation, horizontal and vertical RMS (HRMS, VRMS), and status/description fields for each measurement.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta point measurements (Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, HRMS, VRMS)
metadata.description: A collection of 106 point observations recorded at the Elwha River Delta. Each record includes geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), elevation, a timestamp, and sensor readings (HRMS and VRMS). All observations were taken on 3 February 2012.

metadata.name: UiO PEX permafrost and ground temperature dataset
metadata.description: A collection of files providing mean annual ground temperature, its standard deviation, and permafrost probability fractions for the Arctic region, together with a thumbnail image, each available via a download URL.

metadata.name: Archive of Interviews and Hunting Registers (El Bizri et al. 2019)
metadata.description: A catalogue of three archived data files related to the El Bizri et al. 2019 study, describing their content (interviews, hunting records, CPUE), file names, formats, sizes and download URLs.

metadata.name: Laboratory measurements of Magallana hongkongensis (oyster) from Zhanjiang – 2016‑06‑01
metadata.description: A dataset of laboratory‑derived measurements for the oyster species *Magallana hongkongensis* collected at a single event in Zhanjiang on 1 June 2016. It includes mechanical properties (area porosity, stiffness, hardness, density, volume), water‑column chemistry (pH, temperature, salinity, total alkalinity, pCO₂, carbonate system parameters), and associated metadata such as sample identifiers, treatment groups, and geographic coordinates.

metadata.name: Aerosol size distribution measurements at Neumayer Station, Antarctica (2018)
metadata.description: Time series of aerosol particle size distribution (dN/dlogDp) measurements taken at the Neumayer research station in Antarctica during 2018. Each record includes the measurement height, timestamp, particle concentration across a range of diameters, and the fixed geographic location (latitude -70.65°, longitude -8.25°) with elevation 42 m.

metadata.name: Neumayer SPUSO aerosol size distribution measurements (2019)
metadata.description: Hourly aerosol particle size distribution (dN/dlogDp) measurements recorded at the Neumayer Station (Antarctica) during 2019, including height, timestamps, latitude, longitude, and elevation metadata.

metadata.name: Bohm et al. 2020 Pangaea dataset file inventory
metadata.description: A table listing the files associated with the Bohm et al. (2020) publication on Pangaea, including file names, formats, sizes, URLs, the associated event, and geographic coordinates of the measurement site.

metadata.name: Macapule Lagoon fish measurements
metadata.description: A dataset of fish biometric and biochemical measurements collected at Macapule Lagoon (lat 25.35, lon -108.5) over the period 2013‑12‑12 to 2015‑08‑31. Each record includes the sampling date, season, interval, individual code, and a suite of variables such as total mass, organ weights (gut, liver, stomach, heart), condition indices (HSI, K, GRI), and biochemical parameters (TPRT, TG, cholesterol, glucose). The data are georeferenced with a single latitude/longitude point for the sampling site.

metadata.name: Macapule Lagoon Water Quality Measurements
metadata.description: A dataset of water‑quality observations collected at three zones of Macapule Lagoon. It includes temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia, nitrate, and phosphate measurements recorded on several dates between December 2013 and June 2015.

metadata.name: Mytilus galloprovincialis laboratory experiment data
metadata.description: Measurements of morphological (Perc, l, h) and seawater chemistry parameters (temperature, pH, salinity, DIC, CO₂, carbonate system variables) for the mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis under different treatments (Control, High CO₂) across developmental stages (1‑cell to D‑larva) collected at a single marine site.

metadata.name: Whale Sightings from PS87 Track (2014)
metadata.description: A collection of 8 whale sighting records observed during the PS87 tracking campaign in 2014. Each record includes the date and time of the observation, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), the identified whale species or group, a certainty rating for the identification, an indicator value, and the associated event label.

metadata.name: Balloon atmospheric observations 2018‑08‑18
metadata.description: Time‑series measurements from a balloon flight on 18 August 2018. Each record includes a timestamp, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), flight height, surface pressure (PPPP), temperature (TTT), relative humidity (RH), wind direction (dd) and wind speed (ff), together with an event identifier.

metadata.name: Geochemical measurements of sediment cores (alkane and diol peak areas) from site 370‑C0023A
metadata.description: Dataset of sediment core samples with identifiers, depth intervals, alkane and diol peak area measurements, and associated metadata such as latitude, longitude, elevation and sampling date.

metadata.name: UPC Sensor Data with Location and Timestamp
metadata.description: A small dataset containing zip‑file binaries of sensor data (identified by the UPC event), each associated with geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation) and a recording date.

metadata.name: Birkeland Cruise Video Dataset
metadata.description: A collection of video recordings from the Birkeland cruise, each linked to an event identifier, file name, size, hash, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) and the recording date.

metadata.name: Atmospheric aerosol chemical composition measurements from PS106 flight track
metadata.description: Dataset of aerosol chemical species concentrations (Cl‑, NO₃‑, SO₄²‑, C₂O₄²‑, NO₂‑, Br‑, F‑, MSA, PO₄³‑, Na⁺, NH₄⁺, K⁺, Mg²⁺) measured at different aerosol size ranges and stages during the PS106/1‑track flight campaign. Each record includes a timestamp, latitude, longitude, and measurement height.

metadata.name: Stordalen sediment core dataset
metadata.description: A collection of sediment core samples from the Stordalen site (latitude 68.35, longitude 19.05, elevation 350 m). The table includes depth of each sample, sample thickness, radiocarbon‑derived ages and uncertainties, material dated, laboratory labels, comments, and event identifiers. It provides point‑location metadata for each core segment.

metadata.name: Nuna WP4 Mackenzie 2019 isotopic water measurements
metadata.description: Isotopic and ancillary water‑sample data collected during the Nuna WP4 Mackenzie 2019 expedition. Each row records a sampling event with station identifier, latitude, longitude, date‑time, water depth, δ¹⁸O, δD and a miscellaneous “d xs” value.

metadata.name: Nuna WP4 Mackenzie 2019 fDOM measurements
metadata.description: Dataset of fluorescent dissolved organic matter (fDOM) and related optical properties collected during the Nuna WP4 Mackenzie 2019 expedition. Includes timestamps, latitude, longitude, station identifiers, water depth, and multiple fDOM spectral peak measurements for each water sample.

metadata.name: Water vapor isotopic measurements (δ¹⁸O, δD) at -70.65°S, 8.25°W
metadata.description: Hourly time‑series of atmospheric water‑vapor properties recorded at a fixed Antarctic site (latitude -70.65°, longitude -8.25°). The dataset includes height, water‑vapor mixing ratio, isotopic ratios (δ¹⁸O, δD), associated uncertainties, number of observations, and elevation for each timestamp from 2017‑02‑17 to 2019‑01‑31.

metadata.name: Ice Core Isotope and Gas Age Measurements (Antarctica, 2006‑12‑09)
metadata.description: A collection of ice‑core measurements taken at a single site in Antarctica on 9 December 2006. The dataset includes depth of ice/snow, gas age, isotopic ratios (δ¹⁸O, δ¹⁸O₂, δ³⁶Cl, δ³⁶Cl₂), event identifiers, latitude, longitude, elevation, and the exact date/time of each measurement.

metadata.name: Geochemical sediment core data from station SO268_043MUC (German collector trial pre‑impact)
metadata.description: Dataset containing elemental concentration measurements (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti, etc.) and associated metadata for sediment core samples (depth, event, elevation) collected at a single location (latitude 11.93056667, longitude -117.0224333) on 2019‑03‑10. Includes sample identifiers, station, area, core number, and the date/time of collection.

metadata.name: Belgian collector trial pre‑impact core geochemistry
metadata.description: Geochemical measurements of sediment core samples from the Belgian collector trial (pre‑impact) including element concentrations, depth, latitude/longitude, elevation and a timestamp for each observation.

metadata.name: Sylt trawl fish dataset
metadata.description: A marine trawl survey dataset collected around the island of Sylt (Germany). Each record includes the sampling label, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), bathymetric depth, date and time of sampling, habitat type, measurements of the fish species *Scomber scombrus* (total length and count), as well as environmental parameters such as salinity and temperature. The data represent individual trawl events (e.g., "Sylt_trawl").

metadata.name: PS122 Survey Images 2020-09-08
metadata.description: A collection of ROV quicklook image file names from the PS122 survey (event PS122/5_61-35) recorded on 2020-09-08, including associated latitude, longitude, and elevation metadata for each image.

metadata.name: GIS zip files and Topographic High Raw Data
metadata.description: A collection of GIS archive files (ZIP) for various locations such as Big Skidder, Black Hills, Blue Hills, Cougar Mountain, and Devils Mountain, together with a Topographic High raw data spreadsheet (XLSX). The dataset lists the filenames of the GIS resources and the associated raw data file.

metadata.name: Mn nodule sample dataset
metadata.description: A collection of marine Mn nodule samples with geographic coordinates, elevation, deposit type, depth, and geochemical measurements (Mn, Fe, Ni, Co, Cu). Each record includes an event identifier, sample type, descriptive notes, and the date/time of collection.

metadata.name: PS80 Expedition B. saida Measurements
metadata.description: A collection of biological and environmental measurements of the fish species *B. saida* obtained during the PS80 expedition. The dataset includes event and specimen identifiers, sampling dates, gear type, water depth, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), elevation, and a suite of morphological and physiological traits such as total length, standard length, weight, sex, condition index, degree of digestion, and stomach measurements.

metadata.name: Lake Constance TP concentrations at Fischbach‑Uttwil (1951‑2010)
metadata.description: Total phosphorus (TP) concentration measurements in the upper 20 m of the water column of Lake Constance, recorded at the Fischbach‑Uttwil site. The dataset includes year of observation, depth information, latitude, longitude, elevation and a brief description of the sampling period.

metadata.name: Mn Nodule Geochemical Composition from PLDS04MV‑109BX (1976‑08‑27)
metadata.description: Geochemical dataset of manganese nodule samples collected at a single deep‑sea site (Latitude 11.072 °N, Longitude 140.047 °W) during the PLDS04MV‑109BX expedition on 27 August 1976. The table provides elemental concentrations (Al, Si, Ca, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ba, Sc, Sb, La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Eu, Tb, Ho, Yb, Lu, Hf, Th, U) for three sample types (topside, underside, bulk) together with metadata such as event ID, sample ID, deposit type, depth, and distance.

metadata.name: Sediment chemistry profile for station M186_50-1GC
metadata.description: A dataset of chemical measurements from marine sediment samples collected at the M186_50-1GC station. It includes sample numbers, depth, temperature, concentrations of various ions (NO3‑, NO2‑, NH4+, PO4³‑, Cl‑, SO4²‑, Br‑, B, Mn, Ca, Fe, Na, Mg, Sr, Si, Ba, Li, K), event identifier, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), elevation, and the date/time of collection. All samples were taken on 15 December 2022 at a single location.

metadata.name: Sediment chemistry profile for station M186_54-1GC (Atlantic Ocean)
metadata.description: A dataset of marine sediment chemical measurements collected at a single station (M186_54-1GC) in the Atlantic Ocean. It includes depth, temperature, concentrations of nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate, chloride, sulfate, bromide, boron, manganese, calcium, iron, sodium, magnesium, strontium, silicon, barium, lithium, potassium, as well as latitude, longitude, elevation, and the sampling date/time.

metadata.name: Laboratory measurements of Limacina helicina seawater chemistry (2019)
metadata.description: Dataset from a 2019 laboratory experiment on the pteropod Limacina helicina, containing water chemistry parameters (temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, nutrients, pH, CO₂, carbonate system variables) and experimental metadata (sample labels, treatments, incubation durations) collected at a single station.

metadata.name: Baltic Sea pCO₂ climatology and trend
metadata.description: A collection of two CSV files containing Baltic Sea pCO₂ data: one providing a climatology of pCO₂ values and another presenting a long‑term trend analysis.

metadata.name: Expedition Sample Dataset
metadata.description: A collection of marine sampling records from various expeditions, including event identifiers, sample IDs, expedition names, timestamps, vessel and station information, gear used, water depth, geographic location (latitude/longitude), and taxonomic identifiers for sampled species along with associated measurements.

metadata.name: Cape Blossom, WA – 2021‑06‑25 7 cm Orthophoto and Related Imagery
metadata.description: A collection of high‑resolution remote‑sensing products for Cape Blossom, Washington captured on 25 June 2021. The dataset includes preview PNGs (RGB, CIR, DSM), a cloud‑optimized GeoTIFF orthophoto, and a zip archive of tiled GeoTIFFs, all at a 7 cm spatial resolution.

metadata.name: Ice core sample measurements from NM01 site (2004‑12‑29)
metadata.description: A collection of ice/snow core measurements taken at a single location (latitude -70.65491, longitude -8.25491) on 29 December 2004. The dataset includes sample identifiers, depth of ice/snow, ice density, depth description, and an associated image for each sample.

metadata.name: Physico‑chemical, Particulate‑matter, and Temperature Data Files
metadata.description: A catalogue of binary files associated with dataset 963863, listing data and metadata files for physico‑chemical measurements, particulate‑matter analyses, and continuous temperature records.

metadata.name: Porites coral core geochemistry – Tiarei A1 (2008)
metadata.description: Geochemical measurements (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) from a Porites coral core collected at the TIAREI‑A1 site (latitude -17.506944, longitude -149.4225, elevation -15 m). The file includes age estimates, event identifiers, and a uniform sampling date of 2008‑07‑01.

metadata.name: Porites coral geochemical measurements from TIAREI-3B (2008)
metadata.description: Dataset of geochemical proxy measurements (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ¹⁸O, δ¹³C) from a Porites coral core collected at the TIAREI-3B site. Includes age model values, latitude, longitude, elevation, and the sampling date (2008‑07‑01).

metadata.name: Flade Isblink Ice Cap Cryoconite Sample Dataset
metadata.description: A collection of cryoconite sample measurements from the Flade Isblink ice cap in Greenland, recorded in August 2022. Each record includes the sampling event, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), timestamp, depth, sample type and comments, as well as a suite of chemical and radionuclide analyses (e.g., LOI, carbon, 137Cs, 210Pb, 214Pb, 241Am, 207Bi, 228Ac, 7Be, 40K, Pu isotopes).

metadata.name: Geochemical measurements from Santiurde_section
metadata.description: A table of geochemical and stratigraphic measurements for sediment samples collected at the Santiurde_section site. Each row includes a sample identifier, thickness, mineral ratios, concentrations of quartz (Qz), clay, calcite (Cal), gypsum (Gp), dolomite (Dol), pyrite (Py), the event name, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), and elevation. The dataset does not contain valid date/time information.

metadata.name: Ice and Snow Depth Observations
metadata.description: Measurements of ice and snow depth (total, top, and bottom layers) along with snow density, recorded at specific latitude/longitude points and timestamps. Each record includes an event identifier, geographic coordinates, depth values, and the date/time of observation.

metadata.name: Daily Weather Station Observations (2018‑2023)
metadata.description: A time‑series of daily weather measurements from a single observation station, including date, temperature (minimum, mean, maximum), relative humidity (minimum, mean, maximum), wind speed (minimum, mean, maximum), solar‑radiation sum, event flag, and site metadata (latitude, longitude, elevation). The record spans from 1 January 2018 to 31 December 2023.

metadata.name: Kiwada Kazusa Chiba River Section Sample Data
metadata.description: A collection of sediment sample measurements from the Kiwada Kazusa river sections in Chiba, Japan. Each record includes a sample identifier, section position, age (years), sediment resistance (SR), reference source, and geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).

metadata.name: Paleomagnetic Virtual Geomagnetic Poles dataset
metadata.description: A collection of paleomagnetic measurements for sediment cores, including depth, declination, inclination, statistical uncertainties, age estimates, and calculated virtual geomagnetic pole (VGP) latitude and longitude for each sample.

metadata.name: Uelzen, Germany satellite image composites (1984‑2023)
metadata.description: A time‑series of 6‑band colour composite GeoTIFF files for the Uelzen area in Germany. Each record provides the observation year, start and end dates of the three‑month acquisition period, the file name of the GeoTIFF, file type, and the geographic coordinates of the site.

metadata.name: Aalen Germany 6‑band color composites (1984‑1986)
metadata.description: A time‑series of six‑band colour composite satellite images for the Aalen region in Germany, covering the period 1984‑1986. Each record provides the observation year, start and end dates of the composite, geographic coordinates of the site, and references to the associated GeoTIFF and shapefile resources.

metadata.name: Marine Sediment Core Geochemical Dataset
metadata.description: A collection of marine sediment core samples with geochemical measurements. Each record includes the sampling event, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), site identifier, literature source, δ34S values, age estimates, sample type, distance to shore, water‑depth description, elevation, sediment depth, sedimentation rate, methane concentration, dominant lithology, CaCO₃ content, total organic carbon (TOC), analytical method, and the date/time of sampling.

metadata.name: Soil Geochemistry Samples with GPS Coordinates and Date/Time
metadata.description: A dataset of soil sample measurements (U, Th, K, density, age dating, etc.) collected at specific geographic locations (latitude/longitude) with associated depth, elevation, and a timestamp for each sampling event.

metadata.name: Radiocarbon dates for archaeological sites in Sabah, Malaysia
metadata.description: A table of radiocarbon dating results for archaeological sites in Sabah, Malaysia. Each row provides the site name, country, province, laboratory label, comments, dating method, uncalibrated and calibrated ages (with uncertainties), reference citation, and the calibrated age range (minimum and maximum).

metadata.name: Geochemical composition of rock samples (PS101/186)
metadata.description: Chemical oxide analysis of rock samples identified by Sample ID, including SiO₂, TiO₂, Al₂O₃, Fe₂O₃, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na₂O, K₂O, P₂O₅ and total, together with the sampling event, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation) and the date/time of collection.

metadata.name: Geochemical analysis of Pleistocene sediment core 112‑680A (Site 680) from Ecuador
metadata.description: A dataset of geochemical measurements (elemental concentrations, isotopic ratios, TOC, etc.) for sediment core samples collected at a single site (Latitude ‑11.065, Longitude ‑78.07783, Elevation ‑272 m) in Ecuador. Each row corresponds to a sample at a specific depth, with associated metadata such as leg, core, section, and the sampling date/time (1986‑11‑05 07:15:00).

metadata.name: Core sample seismic measurements
metadata.description: Dataset of P‑wave travel time, Vp‑a, acoustic impedance (AGR) and related core‑sample properties measured at various depths for a single drilling event. Each record includes depth information, core diameter deviation, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation) and the acquisition date‑time.

metadata.name: Sucha Woda Flood Boulder Measurements
metadata.description: A dataset of boulder diameter measurements taken at multiple sites during the Sucha Woda flood event on 24 July 2018. For each site the dataset provides geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), elevation, number of trunks, and up to 25 recorded boulder diameters.

metadata.name: ANT 1997/98 Radar Profiles
metadata.description: A catalog of Antarctic radar profile files for the 1997/98 season, including netCDF data, KML GIS files, and associated JPEG images. All profiles were collected with the EMR 600 ns pulse instrument.

metadata.name: Laboratory experiment dataset on X. umbellata pulsation
metadata.description: Measurements of X. umbellata pulsation recorded for different tanks and experimental treatments in a laboratory experiment.

metadata.name: Geochemical measurements of Uvigerina spp. isotopes from marine sediment core M78/1
metadata.description: This dataset contains geochemical data from a marine sediment core (Event M78/1_181-3) collected at a single location (Latitude 29.0 °N, Longitude –88.333333 °E). For each depth interval the file provides sediment depth, age, δ13C and δ18O values of the foraminifera *Uvigerina* spp., as well as the elevation of the core and the date/time of sampling.

metadata.name: Geochemical measurements of sediment core samples (978983)
metadata.description: Dataset of geochemical and mineral composition measurements for sediment core samples, including depth, mineral percentages, latitude, longitude, elevation, and sampling date.

metadata.name: Sediment core geochemical measurements from BH‑II site
metadata.description: Geochemical dataset containing depth‑resolved measurements of total organic carbon (TOC), black carbon (BC), calcium carbonate, pH, grain‑size fractions, trace metal concentrations (Pb, Zn, Cu, S, etc.), stable isotope ratios (δ13C, δ15N), and associated metadata (latitude, longitude, elevation, sampling date) for the BH‑II sediment core.

metadata.name: Sediment core measurements with depth, age, SST and location
metadata.description: This dataset contains measurements from sediment core samples, including event identifiers, sample labels, sediment depth, radiocarbon age, cluster assignments, sea‑surface temperature (SST) values with standard deviation, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation) and the date/time of collection.

metadata.name: NPAL04 sediment core measurements
metadata.description: A collection of sediment core data from the NPAL04 event, containing depth, age, geochemical (TOC, TIC, δ13C, δ15N), grain‑size fractions, accumulation rates, and elevation for each sample. Each record includes geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) and the date/time the sample was recorded.

metadata.name: Geochemical measurements for event GeoB16310-2
metadata.description: A small dataset of 15 records containing depth, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), event identifier, geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude), elevation, and a timestamp for the sampling event GeoB16310-2.

metadata.name: Geochemical profile (Depth, TOC, TIC) at 23.8242° N, 87.1703° W
metadata.description: A dataset of sediment geochemical measurements collected at a single site (latitude 23.8241667, longitude -87.1703333) on 23 March 2012. Each record includes depth of the sediment sample, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), elevation, an event identifier, and the timestamp of the measurement.

metadata.name: Geochemical profile (TOC, TIC, depth) for site GeoB16320‑2
metadata.description: A sediment geochemistry dataset containing depth, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), and related measurements collected at the GeoB16320‑2 site. Each record includes the sampling depth, latitude, longitude, elevation, and the date‑time of the observation.

metadata.name: Diatom and microfossil assemblage data from core AMK75-6150
metadata.description: A sediment core dataset (core AMK75-6150) containing depth, age, diatom counts, and a range of microfossil taxa abundances, together with the geographic location (latitude, longitude, elevation) of the sampling site. The table includes 31 depth intervals and associated paleoenvironmental proxy measurements.

metadata.name: MOSAiC Ice Core Measurements (2019‑2020)
metadata.description: Measurements from the MOSAiC expedition ice‑core sampling campaign, providing depth‑resolved concentrations of chlorophyll‑a and phaeophytin together with associated metadata such as location, date, device, depth description, and elevation.

metadata.name: Sediment core 210Pb/137Cs profile – LSMo22-1 (2022‑04‑08)
metadata.description: Depth‑resolved measurements of 210Pb, 210Pb standard deviation, supported and unsupported 210Pb, 137Cs and its standard deviation from a single sediment core (event LSMo22-1) collected at latitude 21.365278 N, longitude –104.568333 W on 2022‑04‑08. Includes elevation of the sampling site.
metadata.spatial: point location (single site) with depth interval ~0.01 m

metadata.name: 210Pb sediment core profile dataset
metadata.description: Measurements of 210Pb activity and associated uncertainties in sediment cores, including depth intervals, latitude, longitude, elevation, and sampling date. The dataset provides both supported and unsupported 210Pb values for each depth segment.

metadata.name: Geochemical profile of sediment core LTp22‑1
metadata.description: Measurements of elemental concentrations (CLR) in sediment core samples (Depth sed) with associated ages, location (latitude, longitude, elevation) and sampling date. Includes a suite of major and trace elements (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta) and an icoh/coh scatter value for each depth interval.

metadata.name: M. balthica shell length and frequency data from the EMB320 expedition at Rönnebank (Baltic Sea) – June 2023
metadata.description: Measurements of the marine bivalve *Macoma balthica* (shell length and length‑frequency distribution) collected during the EMB320 expedition at the Rönnebank site in the Baltic Sea. The dataset includes the expedition identifier, sampling location, sampling month, site type (Marine Protected Area), individual shell lengths and corresponding frequency counts for each sampled length class.

metadata.name: Lanaittu core sediment composition
metadata.description: Mineralogical and physical measurements of sediment core samples (Sample label, depth, mineral percentages, transparency, opacity, etc.) collected at the Lanaittu site (latitude 40.2592, longitude 9.5014) on 1994‑01‑01.
